description:
Searches specs by words and filters by category, channel, provider, country, currency, status or capability type.
Returns the matching providers, each with its countries, currencies, sandbox flag, docs URL and the
matching capabilities (name, type, status, example_prompt) — no endpoints, schemas, gotchas or
canonical_example source. Use get_spec with the exact capability name to retrieve the full payload.
A capability with "variants" has several request/response shapes (e.g. one per payment method or
corridor): pass the ones you need to get_spec "variant" to receive only those.

Each result includes a "status" field:
  - "verified": tested against the provider's API, in "sandbox" or "production" (verified_in / verification.environment)
  - "deprecated": the provider is retiring it — get_spec says what replaces it
  - anything else (e.g. "ready", "unverified"): written from the provider's documentation, NOT tested against the live API — may contain errors

Always check the status field. If status is not "verified", inform the user that the spec is experimental and may contain errors.

Args:
  - query (string?): Words, e.g. "wave", "mobile money senegal", "send sms", "kyc", "XOF". Every word must
    match somewhere: provider name or slug, capability, description, example_prompt, countries (code or
    English/French name), currencies, channels (a few synonyms: momo, otp, kyc, payout…). Providers the
    query names come first.
  - category (string?): Filter by category, e.g. "payment", "communications" (SMS, WhatsApp, USSD, voice and email providers — "sms" is accepted as a legacy alias), "identity" (KYC, document verification, AML), "logistics" (delivery and courier providers). The registry adds categories over time: list_providers shows every category that exists
  - channel ("sms"|"whatsapp"|"ussd"|"voice"|"email"?): Only providers that offer this channel
  - provider (string?): Provider slug e.g. "paycard"
  - country_code (string?): ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 e.g. "GN"
  - currency (string?): ISO 4217 e.g. "XOF"
  - status ("verified"|"ready"|"unverified"?): e.g. "verified" for specs tested against the provider's API
  - capability_type ("synchronous"|"asynchronous"|"webhook"|"sdk"?): Filter by capability type

Returns: { providers: ProviderMatch[], note?: string, hint?: string, unverified_count: number, warning?: string }
Each provider may carry "account": who can open its account, with its open questions (see list_providers, which also has the sources).
note is present when a wide result was trimmed to stay readable: example_prompt first, then variants, then the whole account (never an account's answers without its open questions) — it says which; call list_providers for the accounts, get_spec for the variants.
hint is present when nothing matched: widen the search before telling the user a provider is unavailable.
unverified_count counts matching capabilities whose status is not "verified"; warning is present
only when it is > 0.

query.description: Words, e.g. "mobile money senegal" — every word must match
